client.intro.a.speaker: client
text: They said you retired. They said you can't do this anymore. I never believed them.

client.intro.b.speaker: client
text: It's Ines, Owl. The Hale Gallery keeps a ledger in the office off the main hall. Marlow is already in the lobby. The night man is Halloran. Stay out of his way. Bring the ledger out, quietly, and I will forget the rest.

client.intro.repeat.speaker: client
text: Same building. Same ledger. Try not to make it a habit, Owl.
Back again. The ledger's still in the office. Let's see if you've learned anything.

marlow.intro.speaker: marlow
text: I'm in the lobby, boss. Door's ahead of me. Whenever you're ready.
In position. Lobby. One door ahead. Your call.
curt: In the lobby. Door ahead. Go.

marlow.callback.spotted.speaker: marlow

curt: Last time I got seen. Don't do that again.

marlow.callback.ignored_warning.speaker: marlow
text: Last time you sent me out right after I warned you. Patience, okay?
I called out a guard and you pushed me anyway last run. Listen to me this time.
curt: You pushed me past a warning last time. Don't.

marlow.callback.none.speaker: marlow
text: Good to work with you again, boss.
Clean run last time. Let's do it again.

Heading into {room}.

marlow.move.quiet.speaker: marlow

Quietly into {room}. This takes a moment.

marlow.door_noise.speaker: marlow

{item}, right there.

marlow.peek.guard.speaker: marlow

marlow.listen.quiet.speaker: marlow

marlow.wait.speaker: marlow

marlow.take.speaker: marlow

marlow.warning.speaker: marlow

Footsteps, {dir}, and coming. Careful.

marlow.spotted.speaker: marlow

marlow.caught.speaker: marlow

Hands up. It's over, boss.

marlow.win.clean.speaker: marlow
text: We're out. Clean. You did that by ear.

marlow.win.messy.speaker: marlow

Out. Barely. They'll know somebody was here.

marlow.refuse.unknown_target.speaker: marlow

marlow.refuse.not_known.speaker: marlow

marlow.refuse.not_adjacent.speaker: marlow

That's not next door. One room at a time.

marlow.refuse.door_locked.speaker: marlow
text: That door's locked.
Locked, boss.

marlow.refuse.not_in_room.speaker: marlow

marlow.refuse.no_hide_spot.speaker: marlow

There's no cover in this room.

marlow.refuse.no_item.speaker: marlow

marlow.refuse.not_ready_to_exit.speaker: marlow

I can't leave without the ledger, and I need to be by the door.

marlow.refuse.game_over.speaker: marlow

{a}, or {b}?

marlow.alert2.speaker: marlow
text: They know someone's in the building. Radio chatter everywhere.
Alarm's going quiet-loud. They're on alert, boss.

marlow.twist.tape.speaker: marlow
text: Boss. There's a tape taped inside the back cover. A pen label: Fenwick, the ninth. That's the night you lost your sight. I'm bringing it out too.

marlow.nudge.speaker: marlow
text: We're burning time, boss. The ledger's in the office.

marlow.lowtrust.speaker: marlow

marlow.outro.win.speaker: marlow

marlow.outro.caught.speaker: marlow

marlow.chase.speaker: marlow

curt: He's on me! Hide or move!

marlow.chase.escaped.speaker: marlow
text: Lost him. For now.
I'm clear. He's off my back, for now.

marlow.chase.caught.speaker: marlow
text: Too slow, boss. He's got me.
He's on me. It's over.

marlow.guard.alerted.speaker: marlow
text: He heard that. Footsteps turning my way, {dir}.
That was too loud. He's coming this way, {dir}.

client.intro.c.speaker: client
text: One thing. Don't read it. It's only numbers.

client.checkin.speaker: client
text: Report. Do you have it yet? Don't dawdle, Owl.
Owl. Time matters. Tell me you're close.

client.got.speaker: client
text: You have it? Good. Now come out. And Owl, don't open anything else.

marlow.story.hall.speaker: marlow
text: Portraits all down the hall, Hale and his friends, pleased with themselves. It's very quiet, boss.

marlow.story.gallery.speaker: marlow
text: A guest book on a stand, open to the ninth, three years back. The last name signed is Ines Vane. Boss, that's the client.
curt: A guest book. The last name is Ines Vane. The client.

marlow.story.office.speaker: marlow
text: The safe is standing open, and it's empty. But the ledger's lying open on the desk, right in front of me, like a menu. Nobody hides what nobody looks at.
curt: Safe's empty. The ledger's open on the desk.

marlow.story.stairwell.speaker: marlow
text: Stairs going up. There's a radio playing low up there, and someone humming along, off key. He has all night. The metal rings under everything.
curt: Stairs. A radio and humming upstairs. The metal rings.

marlow.story.machine.speaker: marlow
text: The machine picked up. A man says: Ines, it's Hale. Halloran says you want the ledger gone. Burn it before Owl reads it. Call me.
curt: The machine: Hale to Ines. Burn the ledger before Owl reads it.

marlow.story.machine.late.speaker: marlow
text: The machine is blinking. I played it. A man says: Ines, it's Hale. Halloran says you want the ledger gone. Burn it before Owl reads it. Call me.
curt: The machine: Hale to Ines. Burn the ledger before Owl reads it.

marlow.epilogue.ask.speaker: marlow
text: That was Ines on the tape, boss, and I could hear keys behind her. Halloran's. Burn it, or send it?
curt: That's Ines, with Halloran's keys behind her. Burn it, or send it?

marlow.epilogue.retry.speaker: marlow
text: Burn it, or send it, boss?

marlow.epilogue.burn.speaker: marlow
text: Burning it. Ashes in the rain. It stays between you and her, boss, whenever you want to ask her why.

marlow.epilogue.send.speaker: marlow
text: Sending it. By morning the whole city hears her voice, and what happened at Fenwick. I'm sorry, Owl. I'll be here.

client.after.burn.speaker: client
text: Owl. I know you have it. Thank you. I'll never ask for anything again.

client.after.send.speaker: client
text: Owl, pick up. Please. Owl.

marlow.story.limp.speaker: marlow
text: Step, then a drag. Keys on a belt. Boss, that's what you told me you remember from Fenwick. A heavy step, a drag, and keys. That's him. That's Halloran.
curt: Step, drag, keys. Fenwick, boss. That's Halloran.

marlow.talk.speaker: marlow
text: Loud and clear, boss. I'm here.
I'm here, boss. Say the word.

marlow.refuse.no_hide_spot.known.speaker: marlow
text: Nothing to hide behind here. {prop} in {room} would work.
No cover in here, boss. Try {prop} in {room}.

marlow.refuse.no_hide_spot.chase.speaker: marlow
text: No cover in here. Move me, boss! Now!
Nowhere to hide! Get me out of this room!

client.tape.speaker: client
text: Keep him inside, Halloran. Not a word to him. When the lights go out, Owl does not leave this building.

marlow.nudge.office.speaker: marlow
text: The ledger's in the office off the main hall, boss. Want me to head there?
curt: The ledger's in the office, boss.

marlow.nudge.take.speaker: marlow
text: It's right there on the desk, boss. Want me to take it?
curt: Ledger's on the desk. Take it?

marlow.nudge.exit.speaker: marlow

marlow.lore.unknown.speaker: marlow

marlow.lore.ines.2.speaker: marlow

marlow.lore.ines.3.speaker: marlow

marlow.lore.halloran.0.speaker: marlow

marlow.lore.halloran.1.speaker: marlow

marlow.lore.halloran.2.speaker: marlow

marlow.lore.hale.0.speaker: marlow

marlow.lore.hale.1.speaker: marlow

marlow.lore.hale.2.speaker: marlow
text: Hale owned the building at Fenwick, and he kept the tape as insurance. It was taped inside his ledger.

marlow.lore.fenwick.0.speaker: marlow
text: Fenwick is the job where you lost your sight, boss. All you remember is a step, a drag, and keys.

marlow.lore.fenwick.1.speaker: marlow

marlow.lore.fenwick.2.speaker: marlow

marlow.lore.ledger.2.speaker: marlow

marlow.lore.tape.0.speaker: marlow

marlow.lore.marlow.0.speaker: marlow

marlow.alarm.half.speaker: marlow

marlow.alarm.last.speaker: marlow

The doors are closing! One move!

marlow.alarm.caught.speaker: marlow

guide.help.start.speaker: guide
text: This is the start screen of Marlow, a heist you play by ear. You are Owl, a blind fixer. Marlow is your eyes inside a gallery. Put on headphones. Press Tab to reach the Start the job button, then press Enter. Open the Briefing tab to hear the whole story and the rules read aloud.

guide.help.play.speaker: guide
text: You are in the game. Speak an order, or type it in the order box and press Enter. If the microphone is not always listening, hold Space to talk. Keys one to seven are quick actions. You can ask Marlow questions that cost nothing, like what do you see, or how long do we have. Press Escape to skip what she is saying, and O for audio only mode.

guide.help.brief.speaker: guide
text: This is the Briefing tab. Press the Listen to the briefing button to hear the story and the rules. You can also choose a different case here, or write a new one from a real heist.

guide.help.case.speaker: guide
text: This is the Case File tab. It shows how your run went, with pictures. The button makes a comic of your run, which takes about a minute and needs the game server.

guide.help.spec.speaker: guide
text: This is the Spectator tab. It reveals where the guard really is. It is a spoiler for the player, meant for a sighted partner.

guide.help.set.speaker: guide
text: This is the Settings tab. You can change the volume of the voices, music and effects, turn on rain ambience, mono audio and captions, or make Marlow forget your past runs.

guide.help.end.speaker: guide
text: The run is over. Press Tab to find the Run it again button.

guide.help.pick.speaker: guide
text: Marlow is waiting for your answer about the tape. Say burn it, or send it, or press Tab to reach the two buttons.

guide.brief.start.speaker: guide
text: The briefing.

guide.brief.job.speaker: guide
text: The job. You are Owl, once the best fixer in the city. Three years ago, on the night of the Fenwick job, the lights went out and you lost your sight. All you remember is a sound: a heavy step, a drag, and keys. Marlow is your eyes: young, brave, the only one who still calls you boss. Your old partner Ines sends you both into the Hale Gallery for one ledger. She says: don't read it, it's only numbers.

guide.brief.how.speaker: guide
text: How to play. Wear headphones. The whole picture is three D sound: you can hear which direction the guard is in. Speak an order, type it, or press a key in the playbook. Marlow tells you what she sees. You only know what she tells you, and what you hear.

guide.brief.goal.speaker: guide
text: Your goal. Get {item} and bring it out through {room}, without being caught. Doors are noisy. The guard hears them and walks toward the sound. If he spots Marlow he runs at her, and you have exactly one turn to hide or leave the room.

guide.brief.alarm.speaker: guide
text: The silent alarm. Taking the item sets it off. You have {count} moves to get out. Waiting for the guard to leave no longer works. Ask, how long do we have, at any time, to hear how many moves are left.

guide.brief.tape.speaker: guide
text: The ending. If you win, Marlow plays you a tape she found. Say burn it, or send it.

guide.brief.say.speaker: guide
text: Things to say. Listen. What do you see. Go to the hall. Peek the left door quietly. Hide. Take it. Go back. Exit. You can also ask Marlow questions, like who is the client, or where can I hide. Questions cost nothing: no move passes.

guide.brief.engine.speaker: guide
text: One last thing. The game engine decides what happens. The A I only understands what you said.

guide.brief.cast.speaker: guide
text: The players. Owl: the voice in her ear. That is you. Marlow: the eyes. Ines: the client, an old partner. Halloran: the night man. Hale: he owns the gallery, and the ledger.

guide.brief.end.speaker: guide
text: That is the briefing. Press Tab to continue.
